reviews.comment: Dr. Sideris is the Google of structure! But assignments are damn hard, consist only 15% of total grade! Mid 2 was bit complicated than Mid 1, but the final was the toughest! If you want to get an A, you need to make sure your points in each section of course. TBH, he is a great professor, if you want to learn Structural Dynamics in detail.

reviews.comment: Course is not very well organized. He is okay at teaching. Could do a lot better. His accent is little bit difficult to understand. I never felt the class to be interesting. Since it's mandatory attendance most of the students attended. I felt It's better to watch some lecture videos on internet than taking his course.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: I would recommend this professor. He has great notes and is an excellent lecturer. He doesn't just sit and talk, he's great about trying to get people excited about the material. Homework is difficult, but that's the most important thing to study for the tests. Labs are done in, and usually can be completed in class. Take this professor if you can!
